summary: In Ansible 11.13.0, junipernetworks.junos is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 14 unless someone maintains it.
questions: Is the Juniper junos collection being removed from Ansible?
When will junipernetworks.junos leave the Ansible package?

answer_card.title: junipernetworks.junos deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `junipernetworks.junos` is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 14 unless someone starts maintaining it again.
